verdict: clear: bounded metadata-only private preview codec and background storage wrapper
reviewed_behaviors: Only metadata and declared category ancestry are encoded; streams, episodes, playback cursor and account state are absent. Cache rows require the current registry fingerprint and bind to the actual current Provider objects.

Strict work-key and declared-family regeneration prevents a cache row from changing grouping or leaking across fixed tabs. Duplicate source identity and duplicate group key are rejected; incomplete or malformed payloads are ignored by the optional load path.

24-hour age/future/schema checks,512KiB UTF8 cap,64 nesting depth,36 groups,120 complete candidate models and32 category ancestors bound parsing/storage. An empty refresh cannot replace a last-good file.

All I/O and policy projection run on a dedicated single worker with bounded queue2. Delivery is asynchronous, checked against close, and carries only immutable groups. Stock platform AtomicFile owns commit/failWrite recovery.
Canonical app-cache directory and enum-derived filename are checked against their resolved parent; no executable code, remote configuration or media payload is restored.
Candidate metadata fields remain source declarations; detail and playable endpoints must be fetched fresh by callers. The cache does not restore network cursors or promise source availability.
limitations: Read-only independent semantic review plus verification of the existing30/app codec test artifacts and source bindings. Android private disk I/O,AtomicFile crash recovery and UI startup timing were not executed on a device.
